extraction.Name: Luther Arcoran
extraction.Recorded patent: A certified copy of the patent was reported April 2, 1920
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Luther Arcoran and Lillian Arcoran conveyed the land to Edward L. McHenry for a consideration of $12,000
extraction.Buyer: Edward L. McHenry for a consideration of $12,000
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: levied on the land April 3, 1920 to recover $3500.00 on account of a sale and exchange of the land
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739691; southeast quarter of section 19, township 100, range 76; receipt for patent signed June 17, 1920 by E. O. Frescoln; levy started by William J. Bordeaux, sheriff of Tripp Co.; cancellation of the levy provided by Section 2452 Revised Code of South Dakota, 1919; conveyance dated April 14, 1920

extraction.Name: Frank Arcoran
extraction.Recorded patent: The fee patent was recorded May 18, 1920 by E. E. Frescoln. No receipt was issued for this patent.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Frank Arcoran conveyed the land to William Lynass for a consideration of $9,000
extraction.Buyer: William Lynass for a consideration of $9,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739690; southwest quarter of section 17, township 100, range 76; Frank Arcoran died June 19, 1920; heirs are Jack or John Arcoran and Josephine Arcoran; deed executed by Frank Arcoran dated May 17, 1920
